# BENCHMARKS

Indicative single-host numbers (release build). Reproduce with `make bench`. Not a controlled
multi-region run — those are M2 (§21).

| Operation | Per-op | Throughput |
|---|---|---|
| Full credential verify — 9 steps (hybrid Ed25519+ML-DSA-65, SLH-DSA checkpoint, RFC 6962 inclusion) | 406.6 µs | 2459/s |
| Canonical encode (representative claim body) | 327 ns | 3054997/s |

- verify: 793 vectors × 5 iterations = 3965 verifications.
- SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s *signing* is the slow primitive (~0.2 s/op); *verifying* is fast — which is why a
  real log signs one checkpoint and serves many inclusion proofs.
